source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 4 同主题完形(志愿者收包裹/许媛在加纳/演讲谈中国援助/为志愿项目出主意/分享经济平台/感恩反思)。用词限本单元/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: A Parcel from Home
passages.text: I have been teaching in this faraway village for about a month now, and today something wonderful happened: I got a (1)____ from home! It took two weeks to arrive and was a little (2)____, but inside there were sweets and a jar of (3)____. It is always so nice to get (4)____ when you live this far away. Life here is simple. There is no (5)____, so in the evenings I work by candlelight. The students wear no cotton (6)____ and have only pencils and paper. At first I felt very (7)____, far from my family and friends. But slowly I have learned to (8)____ to the quiet life. The boys' bright smiles make a real (9)____ to my days. Tonight, eating my sweets, I feel grateful to be (10)____ my life with these kind people.

passages.title: Xu Yuan in Ghana
passages.text: Xu Yuan is a Chinese (1)____ working in Ghana. She says the living conditions there are not as (2)____ as people imagine. Once she even had to (3)____ holes in her roof to keep the rain out. "I don't really (4)____ about my own comfort," she explained. "The only hard thing has been the (5)____ of hot water." She wishes she had brought a (6)____ to boil water, because some of her medicine works better with it. Still, any small discomfort is (7)____ it, she believes, when she thinks of the people she helps. Xu enjoys being pushed out of her (8)____ zone and seeing the world. After she (9)____ from her job, she hopes to continue to help the (10)____. "Everyone deserves the chance to be happy," she said.

passages.title: A Speech about China's Aid
passages.text: Lately, many of us have seen Chinese people on TV (1)____ other countries to develop. We see workers building roads, ports and railways in faraway (2)____. Some people ask whether this is really (3)____ it, when China still has areas in (4)____ of development. For one student, the question was personal. Her mother, a doctor, has been working as a (5)____ in Tanzania. At first the student was (6)____ that her mother had left. But when she learned about the work, she began to (7)____ a different tune. Her mother helped to build a hospital, so patients no longer had to go (8)____ for surgery. It has made a big (9)____ to many lives. Today the student is proud and (10)____ of her mother's choice, and she hopes to become a volunteer herself one day.

passages.title: Planning a Volunteer Project
passages.text: At today's meeting, the students wanted to (1)____ on a volunteer project for this year. "May I (2)____ that we visit the children's hospital?" Tony said. "We could spend (3)____ with the sick children and bring them small gifts." Another student thought they should (4)____ money for poor families instead. "Wouldn't it be better if we did (5)____?" she asked. "We can both raise money and (6)____ a hand at the hospital." Everyone liked this idea, because it would (7)____ a real difference to more people. They also agreed to (8)____ up a small team to plan the activities. "Let's not just talk about it," Tony said. "Let's (9)____ it!" In the end, the class voted, and helping at the children's hospital came at the (10)____ of the list.

passages.title: A New Way of Sharing
passages.text: These days, sharing does not always mean (1)____ things away forever. Online (2)____ now let people share what they no longer use. If you have books, tools or toys (3)____ around your house, you can offer them to someone who is in (4)____ of them. In (5)____, you might borrow something you need from a neighbour. This idea is good for everyone and (6)____ for the planet too, because fewer things are (7)____ away. Some young people have even (8)____ up small groups to share food that would otherwise be wasted. Leftover bread and fruit are collected and (9)____ out to those who need them. In this way, a simple act of sharing can (10)____ a real difference to a whole community.

passages.title: Learning to Be Grateful
passages.text: Before I joined the volunteer trip, I (1)____ so many things for granted. Clean water, warm food and a soft bed all felt (2)____ to me. But living for a week in a simple (3)____ with no electricity changed the way I (4)____ my own life. The family I stayed with had almost nothing, yet they were happy to (5)____ everything they had with me. After every meal we sat round the (6)____ and talked softly. Their kindness taught me to be (7)____ for what I have. Now I never (8)____ leftover food without thinking of them. When I came home, I decided to (9)____ a hand to others whenever I can. Helping people, I have learned, can (10)____ a difference not only to them, but also to me.
